snippet.title: Game Demo Trailer (EN) - Fig and Totems
snippet.description:
Capture-the-flag meets hide-and-seek in this online multiplayer (2-4) party game.

Participate in tournaments where all players hide their totem then hunt everyone else's in 2min30. 

Track them by ear, or ambush your friends and steal theirs before they score. Whoever throws the most totems in the box wins.
______________________
DOWNLOAD FOR FREE - Fig and Totems :
- Steam Demo (PC/Mac) : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4246130/Fig_and_Totems/ 

- iOS : https://apps.apple.com/fr/app/fig-and-totems/id6758409938
